blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The supposed preference of Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp for a longer trial comes off as masochism for Manila Rep. Joel Chua, as the defense lawyers seem to enjoy seeing themselves ‘beaten and bloodied’ continuously. Chua, a member of the prosecution panel, said this during a press briefing on Friday as he believes the defense has been beaten badly already, even as they have just started presenting their own set of witnesses. If the defense is already beaten badly, Chua asked why it appears that members of Duterte’s camp, like her spokesperson Atty. Paolo Panelo, question the prosecution’s […]...
